name: Applied Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
summary: An applied data-science degree built around project work with real clients rather than around theory, and the one BUas programme where mathematics decides anything: a mathematics test carries the largest single share of the selection score, and the pass line for selection is published as a percentage.

notes: A full IB Diploma is compared by Nuffic to a vwo diploma, and BUas offers a three-year track to applicants whose diploma is comparable to vwo. The standard hbo bachelor recorded on this programme is four years and 240 ECTS; the length of the short track was not established here, so it is not recorded as a credential.
